_comment: SRB2's own default keyboard (the FPS scheme), as Chimera names its keys: Chimera merges left and right modifiers by default, so Spin is Shift and Center View is Ctrl; Fire and Fire Normal are the mouse buttons SRB2 also gives them (its Right Ctrl and Right Alt would merge), and Weapon Next/Prev, the mouse wheel in SRB2, which Chimera cannot bind, are E and Q.
